title: @Ginger Minj @MusicTheaterWorks #gingerminj #lacageauxfolles #jerryhe...
transcript: after two years my very best theater friend Katy and i reunited to see La Cage Aux Folles At the north shore center for the performing arts In Skokie illinois presented by music theater works Now music theater works has had some branding and leadership changes over the years but i really think they’ve found their groove look at this space they made it look like a little french night club so fun way to set the scene so the star of this production is Ginger Minj from rupaul's drag race now Katy didn't know who Ginger Minj was - never watched drag race i have always been a fan of ginger Minj and knew that she would deliver and oh boy does she it is such a great performance it's funny it's touching it's really well song i think it's great to have an actual drag performer play this role there's a real lived in experience there that you can't get from anything else great the production team is fantastic a - costumes, sets all wonderful the cast is phenomenal everyone has a moment to shine if you happen to not catch ginger Minj, her understudy is the great Honey West i guarantee you won't be disappointed it was a really fun night out the theater i can't recommend it enough go see it it's playing through april 3rd
showTitle: La Cage Aux Folles at North Shore Center
